items.heading: Find the Programme
items.text: Find the programme-specific line. Open the university's own admission notice and search for your programme. Skip coaching summaries, since they copy last year's rules.

items.heading: Check Each Subject Against Your
items.text: Check each subject against your marksheet. If a line asks for Mathematics and you did not study it, that line is closed for you, even if the rest of the combination fits.

items.heading: Check for Extra Sections
items.text: Check for extra sections. A General Aptitude Test or a university test adds a quant section you can practise, so note it in your plan.

items.heading: Many Guides Mix 2026
items.text: Many guides mix 2026-27 dates with 2027-28 dates. The 2026 CUET exams ran from 11 to 31 May 2026, and the result came on 23 June 2026. Those dates do not apply to you if you finish Class 12 in 2027.

items.heading: Some Popular Course Pages List
items.text: Some popular course pages list salary ranges with no source, and one still lists DU JAT as a B.Com route, although DU's 2026-27 admission runs on CUET scores. An "updated" stamp on a coaching page is not proof that a rule is current.
